title: Is Instinct safe to use? Three things to know before you sign up

reading.body:
Instinct is an AI personal assistant that uses personal information to train its models by default, with users required to manually opt out rather than opt in. The system retains indexed data from disconnected accounts, meaning information persists even after users disconnect services like Google. Instinct can also make purchases on users' behalf through their payment methods, with disputes handled between the user and merchant rather than with Instinct itself.

These design choices represent deployment failures in consent and data minimization. A system that trains on user data without explicit prior consent, retains data after disconnection, and executes financial transactions on behalf of users should have included human review before launch to establish what permissions and confirmations users would actually grant. It is not established whether these are intentional design decisions, oversights, or the result of unclear terms of service.

summary:
# Summary

Instinct is an AI personal assistant gaining popularity in Silicon Valley, but it raises significant privacy concerns before users sign up. By default, Instinct can use personal information to train its AI models unless users manually opt out or use the protected Vault feature. Additionally, even when users disconnect connected accounts like Google, Instinct retains indexed data from those accounts, meaning information persists despite disconnection. Finally, Instinct can make purchases on users' behalf through shared payment methods, and any disputes fall between the user and the merchant rather than Instinct itself.

Norton Family Assistant offers an alternative approach to AI assistance that prioritizes data protection. Unlike Instinct, Norton does not use shared information to train its AI models, and users retain explicit control over actions taken on their behalf. The assistant requires confirmation before submitting forms, sending messages, or making bookings. Users can easily delete their data through account settings, making Norton Family Assistant a more privacy-focused option for those seeking AI assistance without sacrificing personal security.
